entries.title: Rubio says Cuba is threat to US as Havana accuses him of 'lies'
entries.snippet: Cuba's foreign minister accused Rubio of trying to "instigate a military aggression".

entries.snippet: A video showing a far-right Israeli minister taunting activists who were kneeling with their hands tied behind their backs has been widely condemned.

entries.title: Pair arrested after boys abandoned by road in Portugal
entries.snippet: The children were carrying backpacks with food and water but no identity documents when they were found by a driver.

entries.title: Nvidia's latest record earnings fail to impress investors
entries.snippet: The chip giant reported more stellar results but its shares fell after-hours as investors wonder if it can keep up its pace of growth amid greater competition.

entries.title: Charges dismissed against official at school where six-year-old shot teacher

entries.title: Man who murdered teen TikTok star in Pakistan gets death sentence
entries.snippet: Sana Yousaf's murder highlights a pattern of violence against women in Pakistan, activists say.

entries.title: Trump's Greenland envoy faces uphill battle on mission to make 'friends'
entries.snippet: Jeff Landry's visit to the territory, a semi-autonomous part of Denmark, has touched a nerve among some Greenlanders.

entries.title: Nigeria arrests former minister in hiding after corruption conviction
entries.snippet: The former power minister was sentenced to 75 years in jail in absentia earlier this month.

entries.title: From AI to interceptors, Ukraine is trying to drone-proof its skies

entries.title: Samsung strike on hold as workers push for AI bonus
entries.snippet: The walkout, which was due to start on Thursday, has been suspended while union members vote on a tentative deal.

entries.title: NASCAR superstar Kyle Busch dies at 41 after hospitalization with 'severe illness'
entries.snippet: Kyle Busch, who won more races than anyone across NASCAR's three national series, has died at 41. A joint statement from the Busch Family, Richard Childress Racing and NASCAR said he died after being hospitalized.

entries.title: Trump's towering arch clears another federal hurdle, despite public pushback
entries.snippet: The Commission of Fine Arts gave the arch design its final approval, even though it's missing some visual components. The president said Thursday that he doesn't need approval from Congress.

entries.title: American passenger feels 'betrayed' by federal order to stay in hantavirus quarantine
entries.snippet: Two passengers from the cruise ship that had a hantavirus outbreak were blocked by the federal government from leaving the quarantine unit. One says she is being detained against her will.

entries.title: Republicans stall votes on partisan ICE funding amid party infighting
entries.snippet: Republicans planned to vote on a major funding bill for Immigration and Customs Enforcement this week but plans collapsed amid GOP rancor over Trump's policy demands.

entries.title: Palestinians drop bid for a senior U.N. role after U.S. pressure
entries.snippet: The Palestinian delegation to the United Nations has dropped its bid to secure a top U.N. job after the U.S. threatens to revoke their visas.

entries.title: Democrats wanted answers for what went wrong in 2024. Now, there are more questions
entries.snippet: The Democratic Party wanted a review of the 2024 election. Then, the DNC learned the report was incomplete and unverifiable, party chairman Ken Martin said Thursday, releasing an annotated version.

entries.title: Abortion pills "just in case"? Planned Parenthood will offer them in two states
entries.snippet: In Washington state and Hawaii, residents can now get mifepristone and misoprostol from Planned Parenthood to keep in their cabinets in case they need to end a pregnancy at a later time.

entries.title: Forecasters expect slightly fewer hurricanes than usual this year, but the risk of destructive storms is still high
entries.snippet: Forecasters expect 8 to 14 storms will form in the Atlantic between June 1 and November 30. But the danger is more serious than the numbers suggest.

entries.title: After the sirens: Lebanon's first responders swing between duty and grief
entries.snippet: Nearly 3,000 people have been killed and nearly 1 million have been displaced the war in southern Lebanon began in March. Nearly 400 have been killed since a ceasefire began in April.

entries.title: A trillion dollar question: Will SpaceX's Starship launch go well?
entries.snippet: Ahead of a much anticipated IPO, SpaceX is carrying out a critical test of its giant, stainless steel rocket. Investors will be watching closely.

entries.snippet: Kyle Busch, a two-time Cup Series champion who won more races than anyone across NASCAR's three national series, has died. He was 41.

entries.title: 4 takeaways from the DNC's long-awaited 2024 election autopsy report
entries.snippet: It's never a good sign when a report comes with a big red disclaimer at the top of each page, but that's what happened on Thursday when the Democratic National Committee belatedly released its controversial autopsy report on the 2024 election.

entries.title: WATCH: Democrats rally at Capitol against GOP's immigration enforcement funding bill
entries.snippet: Democrats tried to draw a sharp contrast by highlighting how the White House proposed including $1 billion for security for the White House complex and President Donald Trump's ballroom. Republicans are abandoning that proposal.

entries.title: WATCH: Rubio says Trump prefers Cuba diplomatic solution, but says likelihood 'is not high'
entries.snippet: His comments leave open the option of military action against Cuba, particularly after the indictment this week of former President Raúl Castro on terrorism charges.

entries.title: WATCH: NOAA forecasts milder Atlantic hurricane season thanks to El Nino
entries.snippet: A developing El Nino that is forecast to get quite strong will likely dampen the upcoming Atlantic hurricane season, but it won't make the potentially deadly storms disappear, federal and outside meteorologists predict.

entries.title: Queen Elizabeth was 'keen' for then-Prince Andrew to become trade envoy, documents show
entries.snippet: The government released confidential papers related to the appointment in response to legislation passed by Parliament after lawmakers accused the king's brother of putting his friendship with Jeffrey Epstein ahead of the nation.

entries.title: As losses from scams surge, Congress asks telecoms to do more to prevent them
entries.snippet: A powerful congressional committee is urging major telecommunications companies to do more to protect Americans against scams, part of a widening investigation into the role that U.S. companies play in the surge in cyberscams that cost Americans an estimated $200 billion in 2024.

entries.title: Woman at center of sprawling Minnesota fraud case gets nearly 42-year prison sentence
entries.snippet: A judge on Thursday handed down an extraordinary prison sentence to the former leader of a Minnesota nonprofit who was convicted in a staggering $250 million fraud case that helped ignite an immigration crackdown by the Trump administration.

entries.title: DNC's 2024 election autopsy criticizes Kamala Harris while sidestepping controversial elements of the campaign
entries.snippet: Although the autopsy criticizes Democrats' focus on "identity politics," the report does not address former President Joe Biden's decision to seek reelection, the rushed selection of Harris to replace him on the ticket or the party's acrimonious divide over the war in Gaza.

entries.title: International Court of Justice says workers' right to strike is protected by key labor treaty
entries.snippet: The United Nations' top court issued a landmark advisory opinion on the right to strike on Thursday, finding that a cornerstone labor treaty protects the ability of workers to walk off the job.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump says White House 'won't be a very secure place' without $1 billion security proposal
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump, facing a Senate Republican mutiny, said Thursday that he doesn't "need money for the ballroom," drawing a distinction between the ballroom and proposed White House security improvements.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: France: Part of Eiffel Tower sold at auction for €450,000
entries.snippet: A French collector bought a 14-step staircase section of the Eiffel Tower at an auction in Paris.

entries.title: Turkish court ousts opposition leader in boost to Erdogan
entries.snippet: The 2023 party congress where Ozgur Ozel was elected leader of Turkey's opposition CHP has been declared null and void. The ruling is a legal victory for President Erdogan, but Ozel has vowed not to give in.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia: 1.5 million join Hajj pilgrimage despite war
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia has been directly hit by missiles and drones during the Iran war, but the country is hosting the all-important Muslim pilgrimage anyway.

entries.title: Did US aid cuts worsen Ebola outbreak in Central Africa?
entries.snippet: The Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda are fighting to contain a dramatic Ebola outbreak, which went unnoticed for a long time. Are US aid cuts to blame for the delayed crisis response?

entries.title: Ebola patient in Berlin: Why Germany's helping
entries.snippet: An Ebola‑infected American doctor is being treated under the highest safety standards in a specialized isolation unit in the German capital, Berlin. The facilities are considered to be among the best equipped worldwide.

entries.title: Enhanced Games: Worse than the risk of 'crippling injuries' is the threat of gene editing in sports altering our fundamental human biology
entries.snippet: Doping in sports is nothing new. Athletes at the Enhanced Games will know the risks — severe injury, even paralysis. But bioethicists are also concerned we're opening the gates to altering our fundamental human biology.

entries.title: Germany ready for bigger leadership role in NATO
entries.snippet: As NATO foreign ministers gather in Sweden, German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has made it clear Berlin is ready to take on a greater leadership role in the alliance.

entries.title: Everest: Record 274 climbers summit from Nepal in single day
entries.snippet: A record number of climbers have scaled Mount Everest from the Nepali side in a single day. Despite increasing congestion at the peak, Nepali authorities have sold a record number of climbing permits.

entries.title: DW Exclusive: Germany’s far-right AfD vows to 'make history'
entries.snippet: The AfD looks set to take power in a German state for the first time. In a DW exclusive, the frontrunner in Saxony-Anhalt discusses plans to detain immigrants and revamp the school system, and relations with Russia.

entries.title: Will Germany's aviation tax cut lower ticket prices?
entries.snippet: The tax cut aims to ease the burden on the aviation industry and make flying slightly cheaper. However, some experts warn that it is unlikely to have a meaningful impact on ticket prices.

entries.title: Germany reaches out to Gulf states about Iran war
entries.snippet: Germany no longer believes it can play a mediating role in the conflict between the US, Israel and Iran. Instead, the German government is working to strengthen its ties with the Gulf states.

entries.title: Ebola: Experts warn of scale and spread of deadly virus
entries.snippet: Health experts have warned the world is seeing just the "top of the iceberg" as the deadly Ebola outbreak spreads. Meanwhile, India and the African Union have postponed a scheduled summit due to the health emergency.

entries.title: Czechia: Uproar over Sudeten German gathering in Brno
entries.snippet: The first gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia since World War II is set to go ahead this weekend despite a political backlash that has exposed tensions over one of Central Europe's most painful historical legacies.

entries.title: Kevin Warsh: Trump's man at the Fed or independent voice?
entries.snippet: Never before has a chair of the US Federal Reserve been so controversial. Who is Kevin Warsh? Can he preserve the Fed's independence, or will he become Donald Trump's puppet?

entries.title: Turkey: DW's Alican Uludag released, but trial continues
entries.snippet: A Turkish court has allowed DW reporter Alican Uludag to leave detention as his contentious trial opens. He is accused of having "insulted" President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, which in Turkey can carry a jail sentence.

entries.title: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
entries.snippet: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

entries.title: Will SpaceX's IPO fund life on Mars — and a trillionaire?
entries.snippet: SpaceX is launching history's biggest public listing, propelling Elon Musk's wealth into the stratosphere. DW explores whether the firm's out-of-this-world ambitions are truly cosmic or another black hole for investors.

entries.title: Latvia scrambles NATO jets in drone alert, the latest of several in Baltic
entries.snippet: Latvia's military said NATO planes responded to at least one drone flying in its airspace. It's the latest in a string of such incidents in the Baltic, one of which eventually toppled Latvia's government.

entries.title: Is the US deepening its military involvement in Nigeria?
entries.snippet: Airstrikes in Nigeria led by the US have weakened the so-called Islamic State (IS) terror group. The joint operation shows an expanding US role, but analysts warn of limited long‑term impact and civilian risks.
